title: Read-Only MCP Operator Interface Foundation
goal: Expose safe read-only AegisPT context through an MCP-style operator interface without introducing write actions or runtime mutation.
scope: Define and implement the first read-only MCP surface for run, finding, report, pack, and evidence metadata where appropriate. Keep all write/action tools, scan launches, pack deployment, and secret access out of scope.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Read-only context only. Do not add MCP write tools, scan launch tools, approval tools, deployment tools, or secret access.
notes: The interface must not bypass API authorization, pack approval, or runtime binding.
Prefer explicit allowlists of exposed fields.

success_criteria: A read-only operator context interface is defined and bounded.
Only approved non-secret run, finding, report, evidence, and pack metadata is exposed.
No write/action tools exist in this first slice.
Tests prove sensitive fields and protected secret material are not exposed.
Docs explain the future path for carefully scoped action tools without activating them.
must_not_touch: pack validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: The interface is read-only by construction.
Secret material and unsafe action paths are not exposed.
No runtime behavior changes from MCP access.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The exposed read-only resource list is explicitly documented before implementation starts.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with MCP interface changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the read-only MCP baseline and remaining action-tool limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
